{{Top|leg}}
A '''homing com''' was a type of long-range [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] that emitted a constant signal that allowed the user to track the signal. [[Halor Dinnoral]] used homing coms to tag creatures he [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] for future pickup.
